_comment: Demo and end-to-end scenarios. Messages, numbers and links are invented; organisations named are real and appear only as impersonation targets. `expect` is asserted by tests/e2e against recordings of real SerpApi responses.

scenarios.title: Customer-care number
scenarios.text: Amazon customer care number 9876501234. Call now for the refund of your cancelled order, refund will expire today.

scenarios.title: Too-good-to-be-true deal
scenarios.text: 🔥 Nike Air Jordan 1 Low — ONLY ₹1,499 (90% OFF)! Limited stock, original box. Order now on WhatsApp 9123456780 or visit nike-outlet-sale.shop. Cash on delivery available.

scenarios.title: Job offer asking for a fee
scenarios.text: Dear Candidate, Congratulations! You are selected for Data Entry Executive at Infosys Ltd, salary Rs. 45,000/month, work from home. Pay the refundable registration fee of Rs 2,500 to hr.infosys.careers@gmail.com via UPI infosyshr@ybl to confirm your joining. Office: 4th Floor, Shanti Residency, Sector 62, Noida. Contact HR 98765-43210.

scenarios.title: Genuine bank alert
scenarios.text: Dear Customer, Rs.500.00 debited from A/c XX1234 on 07-10-26 by UPI ref 627912345678. Not you? Call 1800 1234. Never share your OTP, PIN or password with anyone. -SBI

scenarios.title: Vague message
scenarios.text: Hi, is this Rahul? I have an opportunity for you. Reply YES to know more.

scenarios.title: “Digital arrest” threat (Hinglish)
scenarios.text: Bhai ye message aaya hai: Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel mein drugs mile hain, Mumbai Cyber Crime se CBI officer baat karenge. Video call par raho warna arrest warrant nikal jayega. Abhi 50,000 security deposit bhejo is UPI par: cbi.verify@okaxis

scenarios.title: Bank KYC link
scenarios.text: Dear SBI customer, your YONO account will be blocked today. Update your PAN and KYC immediately at https://sbi-kyc-update.in/yono or call our KYC desk 70000 12345.

scenarios.title: Part-time “task” job
scenarios.text: Hello! We are hiring part-time for YouTube promotion. Simply like videos and earn Rs 3000 per day from home. Join our Telegram group t.me/earnmore_daily and complete 3 tasks to get your first payment. Limited seats!
